abstract: Germ cell tumors constitute a very complicated group of tumors of the ovary and their histogenesis is not yet clarified. Besides their histological heterogeneity, sarcomatous areas have also been described. A right ovarian mass was found in a 23-year-old female, who was being treated in the hospital for miscarriage. Disseminated omental metastases were detected during abdominal laparotomy. Pathological examination of the dissected material revealed the tumor to be a mixed germ cell tumor (immature teratoma and dysgerminoma) with sarcomatous component. Areas resembling granulosa cell tumor were also encountered. This ovarian tumor with many different histopathological features is presented with a review of the literature. The importance of thorough sampling in determining the type and extent of the malignant components is also emphasized due to their direct relation with the prognosis.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍は卵巣の腫瘍の中でも非常に複雑な群を成し、その組織発生はいまだ明らかにされていない。組織学的な不均一性に加え、肉腫様の領域も報告されている。23歳の女性が流産で入院中に右卵巣腫瘤が見つかった。開腹手術中に大網への播種性転移が確認された。切除材料の病理学的検討により、腫瘍は肉腫成分を伴う混合型胚細胞腫瘍(未熟奇形腫およびディスジャーミノーマ)と診断された。顆粒膜細胞腫に類似した領域も認められた。このように多彩な組織学的特徴を持つ卵巣腫瘍を、文献的考察とともに報告する。悪性成分の種類と範囲を決定するうえで十分な組織採取が重要であり、それらが予後と直接関係するため強調しておく。
